input:
Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候人觉得祭拜非常重要，孟子很小的时候，从早到晚一直祭拜，因为他妈妈告诉他祭拜很重要。虽然他没有朋友，因为每天只祭拜。他的同学们老是对他开玩笑了。孟子妈妈看了他的同学们对孟子不好的影响，所以孟子和孟子妈妈搬家了。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 古代的时候人觉得祭拜非常重要，孟子很小的时候：在古代，人们，“人“ is too general and too vague, and does not stand alone；better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
- 虽然他没有朋友，因为每天只祭拜：delete虽然，there is no “even though” meaning here
- 他的同学们老是对他开玩笑了：跟他开玩笑，no了for routine/habit
- 孟子妈妈看了他的同学们对孟子不好的影响：看到，看look vs.看到see; 有不好的影响
- 所以孟子和孟子妈妈搬家了：delete孟子和孟子妈妈, redundant

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，the phrase is redundant because 古代 already expresses a time period, while 的时候 also means “the time when.”
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 人觉得：人们觉得，use 人们 for people in general; 人 alone is a generic noun and does not naturally refer to a concrete group of people.
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 看了他的同学们对孟子不好的影响：看到了他的同学们对孟子不好的影响，看 means “look,” while 看到 means “see/notice”; use 看到了 for a completed act of noticing.
4. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 他同学们老是对他开玩笑了：他同学们老是对他开玩笑，老是 describes a habitual action, so it takes the zero aspect form rather than 了.
5. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子很小的时候：有一个叫孟子的小男孩，他很小的时候，孟子 is appearing for the first time, so introduce him with his name and who he is rather than using only the name.
6. [Coherence: connectors, error] Coherence (Conjunction): 虽然他没有朋友，因为每天只祭拜：他没有朋友，因为每天只祭拜，because introduces a cause, while 虽然 needs a contrasting second clause with 但是 or 可是; this sentence only needs the cause connector.

items.reason: 古代 already denotes a time period, so 古代的时候 is redundant under the teacher's rule.
人 cannot refer to this concrete general group here; 人们 is required.
看到了 correctly changes 看 to 看到, but the corrected phrase still lacks 有 in 对孟子有不好的影响.
Removing 了 correctly expresses the habitual action, but the shown correction has ungrammatical 他同学们 instead of 他的同学们.
孟子 is first introduced here and should be briefly identified, but the shown replacement ends with the unfinished temporal phrase 他很小的时候.
虽然 requires a contrasting follow-up, whereas this sentence only gives the cause introduced by 因为.
